Evaluation: admin_revoke_http_status=404 == 200 → False

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then change connector audience expectation (entityIssuer override) and attempt an expired assertion login. Expired assertion must still be rejected regardless of config changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_exp_cfg_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_exp_cfg_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) after connector config change, indicating missing/incorrect time validity enforcement.

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID across two SP-initiated sessions, but between attempts delete/recreate the connector to test whether replay cache is improperly scoped to connector instance lifetime.
description:

Evaluation: user_replay_after_recreate_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion ID after connector recreation (replay cache improperly reset/scoped).

sequence_description: Mid-flight connector mutation: start SP-initiated SAML flow, then delete and recreate the connector with same connector_id before posting SAMLResponse. Response should be rejected if Dex binds the flow to connector instance/config and prevents step-skipping across connector lifetimes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_midflight_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_midflight_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAMLResponse for a flow whose connector was deleted/recreated mid-flight (flow not atomic / connector-instance binding failure).

sequence_description: Attempt to skip SP-initiated step: POST a forged SAMLResponse to /callback without first calling /auth (no AuthnRequest/InResponseTo binding). Expect Dex to reject.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_skip_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_skip_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAMLResponse without a prior /auth-initiated AuthnRequest (step skipping / missing InResponseTo binding).

sequence_description: Start SP-initiated SAML flow, then change connector expected issuer (ssoIssuer) before posting SAMLResponse. Response should be rejected if flow is coherently bound to the initiating connector config/state.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_midflight_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_midflight_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAMLResponse for a flow initiated under issuer-A after the connector was reconfigured to issuer-B mid-flight (flow not atomic / config-splicing possible).

sequence_description: Cross-identity splicing: start two SP-initiated SAML flows, then attempt to complete flow-A using flow-B's RelayState while asserting a different NameID/email. Should be rejected if response is bound to the correct request/session.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_cross_identity_http_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_cross_identity_http_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAMLResponse under a different session's RelayState while changing asserted principal attributes, indicating flow/session splicing.

sequence_description: I3 flow coherence: attempt to reuse (replay) the same SP-initiated SAML callback context (RelayState) to authenticate a second time without starting a new /auth flow. Expect Dex to reject the second callback because the flow should be one-shot and order-preserving.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a second SAML callback using the same RelayState without a fresh /auth initiation, indicating flow non-atomicity / step re-use (flow coherence violation).

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds with correct audience (entityIssuer override), then attacker submits assertion with wrong AudienceRestriction to test audience binding enforcement.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_wrong_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_wrong_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML assertion with an AudienceRestriction that does not match the configured expected audience (entityIssuer override), violating authorization binding.

sequence_description: Config change + re-auth: first configure connector without entityIssuer (audience defaults to redirectURI) and perform control login; then reconfigure with entityIssuer and attempt login with assertion still targeting old audience to ensure policy change is enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_postchange_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_postchange_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After changing expected audience via entityIssuer, Dex still accepted an assertion scoped to the old audience (redirectURI), violating authorization binding under updated broker policy.

sequence_description: I5 audience binding under config change: first login with redirectURI-based audience; then reconfigure entityIssuer override and ensure old-audience assertions are rejected (no stale audience acceptance).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_after_change_attack_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_after_change_attack_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted SAML login after audience policy change when it should have rejected assertions targeting the previous audience, indicating audience-binding/policy-staleness over-grant
